name: Glo Dollar
oneLiner: USDGLO is Brale-issued dollar stablecoin whose reserve yield is directed to extreme-poverty alleviation, redeemable 1:1 against cash and U.S. government debt.
collateral: Cash, cash equivalents, and U.S. government-backed debt held by Brale in segregated, unencumbered accounts
pegMechanism: Brale-issued fiat-backed stablecoin redeemable 1:1 for USD or USDC by eligible Brale customers; Brale manages reserves and liquidity for redemption obligations

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for USDGLO. Brale operates as a FinCEN-registered MSB with state money-transmitter licenses; no OCC charter application or PPSI announcement found as of 2026-06-18.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USDGLO is a GloDollarV3 ERC1967 UUPS proxy deployed at the same address across ETH/Base/Optimism/Celo/Polygon/Arbitrum; Brale issues it 1:1 through their centralized backend. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history shows all roles (MINTER, DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, UPGRADER) consolidated into a single Brale-operated EOA on every chain.

upgradeability.controlRef: Brale operator EOA (sole MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE + UPGRADER_ROLE holder on all 6 EVM chains)

controls.label: Brale operator EOA (sole MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE + UPGRADER_ROLE holder on all 6 EVM chains)
controls.evidence: On 2026-06-11 at ETH block 25295351 / Base 47202617 / Celo 69293825 / Polygon 88326399 / Optimism 152797996 / Arbitrum 472429769: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb180f9…) = true and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb180f9…) = true on all six chains; eth_getCode(0xb180f9…) returned no bytecode on all six chains (EOA, consistent with Brale enterprise key custody). Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked Blockscout scans from deployment show all other historical holders (incl. original deployers) revoked; on Polygon the original deployer 0x03bcc9… reads hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN)=false. 0xb180f9… also holds PAUSER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE (UUPS upgrade authority).

controls.label: Brale issuance backend
controls.evidence: Brale operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for USDGLO for eligible Brale customers against segregated cash and US government-backed debt; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. The single consolidated on-chain operator EOA corroborates the issuer-operated model.

review.evidence: Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log scans on USDGLO (0x4f604735c1cf31399c6e711d5962b2b3e0225ad3) via Blockscout instances on ETH (from deployment block 15921266), Base, Celo, Polygon, Optimism, and Arbitrum show every role (DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER 0x9f2df0fe…, PAUSER 0x65d7a28e…, UPGRADER 0x189ab7a9…) consolidated to 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110 with all earlier holders revoked. Rechecked on 2026-07-14 at ETH block 25530512 / Base 48619144 / Celo 72126877 / Polygon 90215095 / OP 154214430 / ARB 483746760: hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0xb180f9…) is true and eth_getCode returns empty on every chain. ERC-1967 implementation slots resolve to 0xf8dbe4f5… (ETH/Polygon), 0x693b51c1… (Base/OP/Arbitrum), and 0x865dda29… (Celo). Stellar issuer (GBBS25…) has 1 signer, weight=1. Brale-issued model confirmed from issuer materials. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No independent attestor exists: Brale Inc. management self-verifies monthly, with the latest report covering 2026-05-31 and published 2026-06-04. FinCEN and state money-transmitter records match Brale Inc., but MSB/transmitter licensing is AML and payments conduct status rather than prudential stablecoin-issuer supervision.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDGLO has reviewed cross-chain route evidence through Across, an intent/liquidity framework rather than issuer-native settlement, but on-chain reads on 2026-07-20 confirm all seven deployments are issuer-native (identical GloDollarV3 CREATE2 proxies on six EVM chains and a native Stellar asset); the tokens themselves are minted by the Brale issuer backend, not by the Across route.
